notes.title: SSA Patch Notes – 2025_7_2
notes.notes:
Gameplay Adjustments
Mantis Kill Reward: Now granted to all living teammates, not just those nearby.

Minion Balance: Slight reduction in damage and HP to improve early game pacing.

Jungle Tweaks: Non-boss jungle units now deal slightly less damage.
New Feature: Command (Ping) System
A brand-new ping wheel system has been added for faster and more strategic in-game communication:
How It Works:
Hold Left Shift to open the Command Wheel. Move your mouse in a direction to select a command, then release Shift to send it.

Ping via minimap or ally portraits is also supported.

Right-click cancels the wheel.

Keyboard shortcut (1–6) support for fast access.
Anti-Spam Logic:
Sending 5 commands within 5 seconds will lock the system for 5 seconds to prevent spam.
Default Commands:[olist]
Caution

Setting Course

Need Assistance

Enemy Missing

Engage

Survey the Area
[/olist]Contextual Side Commands:
Depending on the target (ally, jungle, structure), commands adapt contextually. For example:

Caution + ally = “X, Fall Back”

Engage + enemy structure = “Attack X”

Need Assistance + base = “Defend X”
Audio Updates
Adjusted engine sounds for Inso, FF machine gun, and all XBT units for better clarity and mix.

SSA Team

notes.title: STEEL SWARM APOCALYPSE PATCH NOTES 2025_3_5
notes.notes:
🧰 Mechanics Updates

- Fast Laner Gear has been reworked into a Support Kit:
- Grants movement speed in base.
- When you last-hit a lane minion, a portion of the earned Xalium is shared with the nearest XBT without a Support Kit, and you receive 20% bonus Xalium.
- If the nearest XBT last-hits the minion, you receive 20% of their Xalium as bonus.
- If no ally is nearby, Xalium gain proceeds as normal.

- Teleportation system updated:
- “Teleport to Portal Drone” can now only be used on your own drone.
- Power Jumper item activated (allows teleportation to teammate’s Portal Drone).
- Teleport to Base and Teleport to Portal Drone cast times increased from 5s → 7s.
- If the target Portal Drone dies during cast time, the teleport is interrupted immediately.

- Fog of War system added to the game.

🔧 General Fixes & Improvements
- Fixed an issue where effects (such as damage) could incorrectly transfer to similar entities upon death.

💬 Launcher Features
- Added direct messaging between players in the launcher.

🎯 Upgrade Adjustments
- In the Permanent Upgrade system, 20% of the damage from the Defender path has been shifted to the Fast Attacker path.

⚙️ Buff & Stat Adjustments
- Jet Fuel (0–15 minutes): Duration reduced to 5 seconds.
- Jet Fuel (15+ minutes): Duration is 10 seconds, effect reduced to 10%.

🔁 Respawn Adjustments
- Respawn modifiers at 35 and 40 minutes have been removed.
- Maximum respawn time is now capped at 92 seconds.
